name: mcp__paper_checks__collect_current_local_citation_evidence
description: Collect local citations; source_id for bibliography, citation_id for metadata. Returns title_needs_review_keys and query_recovery_available; no fact check.

name: mcp__paper_checks__export_current_audit_pdf
description: Export a new task PDF from the approved or finalized report SHA and reviewed renderer.

name: mcp__paper_checks__export_review_report
description:
Export a substantive proofreading report as downloadable PDF and Markdown.
        sections=[{heading,paragraphs:[text]}]; quote actual source wording, explain
        corrections and limitations. source_versions is the full list_inputs
        filename:sha256 map. No original is modified; no empty reference report.

name: mcp__paper_checks__fetch_pinned_cited_preprint_metadata
description: Fetch official arXiv metadata for the bound citations; it does not certify publication.

name: mcp__paper_checks__fetch_pinned_formal_reference_metadata
description: Fetch Crossref candidates for bound source identifiers or titles; model reviews identity.

name: mcp__paper_checks__finalize_current_audit
mcp__paper_checks__list_inputs
description: List only the approved files in this Session, with exact SHA256.

name: mcp__paper_checks__pin_document
description: Pin any listed upload (PDF, Word, CSV, JSON, TXT etc.) to its exact version. No host paths.

name: mcp__paper_checks__pin_paper_citations
description: Pin the approved current manuscript's active citations to a versioned Session handle.

name: mcp__paper_checks__pin_paper_sources
description: Pin the uploaded literal LaTeX main and all current source files to a versioned scope.

name: mcp__paper_checks__read_current_audit
description: Read the task's approved or model-finalized audit report with its exact SHA256.

name: mcp__paper_checks__read_pinned_bibliography_first_page
description: Read fixed page one using only the source_id from collect_current_local_citation_evidence or pin_paper_citations, not pin_paper_sources.

name: mcp__paper_checks__read_pinned_bibliography_page
description: Read page two or later with a source_id from collect_current_local_citation_evidence or pin_paper_citations; never use pin_paper_sources' different handle.

name: mcp__paper_checks__read_pinned_citation_records
description: Read original BibTeX entries for the bound active citation batch.

name: mcp__paper_checks__read_pinned_document
description: Read one PDF page, a bounded source-text page, or the extracted logical page of Word/table uploads. Follow page_count; no visual review.

name: mcp__paper_checks__read_pinned_paper_citations
description: Inspect active literal citations and bind a fresh citation batch; no factual judgment.

name: mcp__paper_checks__read_pinned_paper_sources
description: Use the existing static checker for literal citations, duplicate labels, floats and supplied logs; no compilation or authenticity claim.

name: mcp__paper_checks__recover_pinned_formal_reference_queries
description: Only call when collect reports query_recovery_available=true; pass its citation_id, never source_id. Uses administrator-registered query library.

name: mcp__paper_checks__stage_current_audit
description:
Append typed fields or remove draft references; use returned SHA for the next call.

        For entries from the current BibTeX bibliography, use
        stage_current_bibliography_assessments instead; it copies exact titles,
        keys and file evidence without making the model repeat them.

        scope is text; notes is a list of strings. Each references/sources/issues field is
        a list of report rows (at most eight per call). citation_checks accepts only
        list_without_citation, citation_without_entry, duplicate_entries,
        numbering_anomaly, unresolved_or_abnormal_citations, non_citation_brackets;
        each value has result/evidence/limitation strings. A reference's
        source_ids must name rows in sources; uploaded names belong in evidence_files.
        Missing required fields return staged=false and exact field names without writing.
        "已确认" or "已确认，但需修正" without a staged external source_id is
        rejected; cite the source or mark the item 存疑 pending verification.
        Duplicate reference keys return staged=false without writing. To repair an older
        draft, pass only remove_reference_number or remove_reference_numbers and the
        current draft SHA. The latter removes up to forty distinct one-based rows
        in one call; later rows are renumbered. Neither can change a finalized
        report or uploaded original.

name: mcp__paper_checks__stage_current_bibliography_assessments
description:
Append up to forty assessed BibTeX entries in one versioned draft write.

        Each assessment supplies key, status, priority and explanation;
        source_ids may name previously staged external sources. The server
        resolves a unique key against this task's versioned bibliography and
        copies its original index, literal title and evidence filename. For a
        duplicate key, supply the one-based index from a bibliography page.
        Never use entry_index_in_bib from the active-citation view as index.
        An index/key mismatch rejects the whole batch without writing.
        This does not verify authenticity or assign an unreviewed status. If
        staged=false and validation_error=paper_bibliography_title_needs_review,
        supply short_title for the returned missing_title_index and retry; no
        draft was written. Duplicate BibTeX keys must be reported as an issue.
        Pass the returned draft SHA for explicit compare-and-swap. If omitted,
        the server binds the current task-local draft SHA at this call; an
        explicit stale SHA still rejects without writing.

name: mcp__paper_trace_rsi__apply_revision_plan
description: Apply the model-selected bounded reference plan to a new task copy; preserve other fields.

name: mcp__paper_trace_rsi__export_revision_report
description: Export the current reviewed structural report as Markdown in this task only.

name: mcp__paper_trace_rsi__read_task_state
description: Read the current private reference report and version. No authenticity claim.

name: mcp__paper_trace_rsi__triage_revision_audit
description: Run the existing learned audit program on the current versioned reference report.
